title: Patient Financial Services Policy: Patient Payment Plans Add-Ons and Plan Modifications
content:
This section of the Patient Financial Services policy governs adding new charges to a signed plan under the Patient Payment Plans and changing a plan's terms.

### 5.1 Add-ons

Where the tier permits add-ons, new eligible charges may be added to an active plan, never a delinquent one, while all of the following hold:

- the number of add-ons on the plan is below the tier's maximum add-ons, the number of add-ons being counted as the number of distinct dates on which add-on enrollments were booked over the plan's life;
- the charges added together total at least the tier's smallest add-on amount;
- at least the tier's minimum number of installments still remain;
- the new total stays within the tier's largest balance carried.

### 5.2 Absorption of an add-on (no longer in force)

The clause under which, for tiers that re-spread over the remaining term, the remaining balance is re-spread over the installments left with the same end date, and, for tiers that restart the term, it is spread over a fresh full term from the next due date, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for re-spreading the installment and lengthening the term after an add-on.

### 5.3 When a plan may be modified

A plan is modified only while its status is active. The status is read from the system record of the plan being modified.

### 5.4 Limits on modifications

Each change of installment, due day, automatic debit, term or pause counts toward the tier's maximum modifications, and due-day changes also count toward the tier's maximum due-day changes. A change beyond either limit is refused.

### 5.5 Term extension on request

Where the tier permits term extension, the term may be lengthened by up to the tier's maximum extension months in total, re-spreading the remaining balance. The installment may never fall below the tier's minimum installment.

### 5.6 Automatic debit on tiers that require it

Removing automatic debit from a tier that requires automatic debit is not allowed; the patient may only switch the debit method.

### Add-on conditions at a glance

| Condition | Satisfied when |
|---|---|
| Tier | Add-ons permitted |
| Plan status | Active (a delinquent plan takes no add-on) |
| Add-ons already on the plan | Fewer than the tier's maximum |
| Size of the add-on | Charges added together at least the tier's smallest add-on amount |
| Installments remaining | At least the tier's minimum |
| Plan total afterwards | Within the tier's largest balance carried |

### Modification counting (hypothetical)

On a hypothetical plan whose tier allows 4 modifications and 2 due-day changes, and which already shows 3 modifications of which 2 were due-day changes: a request to switch the debit method is the fourth modification and is within both limits; a further request to change the due day would be a third due-day change and is refused, whatever the modification count.

superseded_clauses: Under add_on_method reamortize_remaining_term the remaining balance is re-spread over the installments left (same end date); under restart_term it is spread over a fresh full term_months from the next due date.
